highlights.title: CHI Workshops on Computational UI
description: Organized three CHI workshops on computational user interfaces

bullets: Collect and analyze high-quality, **design-focused data** for mid-training and post-training, working with frontier labs
Lead the **harness design and evaluation** of an agent-focused canvas-based design tool
Lead development of the **FrontierDesign benchmark**, covering methodology, data collection, evaluation criteria, and branding
Developed the [**Krea AI**](https://krea.ai) web app to support creative control with AI models
Served as a core contributor to [**Krea Nodes**](https://krea.ai/nodes), a canvas-based AI image and video generation tool
Led the design and engineering of a growth-focused user referral program and redesigned the blog page

experience.summary: Developed **Seep**, an iOS app that turns personal daily journals into visual stories for reflection and well-being

bullets: Led [**Misty**](https://github.com/yuwen-lu/Misty): UI prototyping through **interactive conceptual blending** with multimodal AI
Paper accepted at [**CHI 2025**](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3706598.3713924) and featured on [Apple ML Research](https://machinelearning.apple.com/research/interactive-prototyping)
Prototyped AI-powered checks for Material Design guideline violations
Published a CHI 2024 case study on AI adoption in UI linting, with ongoing **internal adoption**

projects.note: Work done during internship at Apple
projects.title: Misty: UI Prototyping Through Interactive Conceptual Blending ([Demo](https://x.com/yuwen_lu_/status/1850574331539276198))
bullets: Designed and developed novel interactions for UI prototyping with frontier AI models, implemented with Next.js and GPT-4o
Explored direct manipulation techniques, such as drag-and-drop, to support borrowing inspiration from references as an alternative to prompting
Paper accepted at [CHI 2025](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3706598.3713924) with concrete product impact at Apple

projects.title: Crepe: A Mobile Screen Data Collector Using Graph Query
bullets: Designed and built an Android app that supports precise data collection of screen text data for algorithm auditing
Used a novel Graph Query algorithm and Android Accessibility API to parse and retrieve the target data
Achieved 96.0% F1 for data collection with low background battery use
Paper accepted at CHI 2026 with a **Best Paper Honorable Mention Award**

projects.title: Dark Pita: A Browser Extension Against Dark Patterns
bullets: Developed a browser extension enabling users to understand and customize websites to avoid manipulative designs (i.e., “dark patterns”)
Built using Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, and Firebase; [open-sourced the code](https://github.com/yuwen-lu/dark-pita)
Won the **Best Paper Award** at CSCW 2024 (top 1% of accepted papers)
